description:
Supply FlowQC helps hospital and healthcare procurement teams find medical products, compare prices, and ask a distributor about availability, all from a ChatGPT conversation.

Search the catalog by product name, description or category, or describe what you need in plain words. Each result shows the manufacturer, the manufacturer part number, and the lowest price across distributor offers.

Look up distributors by name to see which are active and how many products each one carries.

When you are ready to source a product, ask a distributor about availability or a quote. Supply FlowQC emails the distributor's procurement contact for you, with your address as the reply-to, so the conversation continues in your own inbox. An inquiry goes out only when you ask for one, and each account has a daily limit.

Sign in with your Supply FlowQC account. You can see and revoke the connection at any time under Settings → Connected Apps. Supply FlowQC works with product and procurement data only and never asks for patient information.

defaultPrompt: Find nitrile exam gloves and show me the best prices
Find something to keep a patient's bed dry
Ask Howard Medical if nitrile gloves are in stock
